contents: Complete runnable working tree (git-ready). node_modules/dist/.git excluded; run npm ci to install.
corrective_scope: Responds to the independent audit findings F1-F5 against the Batch 10.4 Second Corrective packaging delivery. No Batch 10.5 work performed. No UI, clipboard, download, backup, restore, Prompt Pack, rendered-image, persistence-write, or external-integration work performed.

findings_addressed.F1: A shape-valid plan whose Output B is linked to the wrong Output A (or whose numbering disagrees with an otherwise-consistent selection) now fails the whole packaging operation (existing EXPORT_LINK_001 code, no bytes) instead of silently packaging the B prompt under a false relationship while only suppressing the pair-execution file.
findings_addressed.F2: Pair-file eligibility is matched on the complete (sessionId, sceneId) identity throughout (package-plan.ts), not sceneId alone, closing a cross-session leakage path where a shape-valid hostile plan reusing a scene id across two sessions could let one session's real Output A/B authorize a pair file in another session with no selection of its own.
findings_addressed.F3: The ZIP verifier (zip-verifier.ts) now proves the local-entries region is one exact, contiguous, canonical byte sequence (no prefix, no gaps between entries, no bytes before the central directory, no reused/overlapping local offsets), closing a gap where hidden bytes - including image signatures - outside every declared entry went completely unaccounted for.
findings_addressed.F4: The public writeDeterministicZip writer (zip-writer.ts) now rejects unsafe paths (traversal, absolute, drive-prefixed, UNC, backslash, empty/dot segments, control characters) directly, independent of any caller-side check, with duplicate-path and unordered-entries kept as distinct, precise reasons from path-unsafety.
findings_addressed.F5: Corrected evidence/test accuracy: the symlink-specific check now runs before the generic non-zero-external-attributes check so its exact reason is reachable and asserted; several structural mutation tests now assert precise reasons instead of a bare ok:false; the partial-pair exact matrix test asserts the exact preserved Output B omission; a genuine multi-scene GROUP scope case was added (distinct from the pre-existing multi-scene session case).

source_tree_combined_hash.note: scripts/source-tree-hash.mjs explicitly excludes CHECKPOINT-MANIFEST.json and CHECKSUMS.txt by exact relative path (documented in the script itself), because a combined hash that embeds itself in one of the files it hashes can never reproduce - the act of writing the value changes the bytes that produced it. This value is reproducible on any clean extraction: editing CHECKPOINT-MANIFEST.json or CHECKSUMS.txt afterward does not change it, since both are now outside the hashed set. Verify with: sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.txt && node scripts/source-tree-hash.mjs.
